verdict.reasons: The image fails due to a core branding defect: the text label 'Drip Irrigation Tape' contains a clear spelling error ('Irrigation'), which constitutes unreadable or fake/altered branding. While the installed irrigation geometry and wet soil strip evidence are correct and integrated plausibly into the scene, the explicit product label error disqualifies the image from passing.

focused_physical_review.reason: A continuous black drip irrigation line is visible running on the soil immediately adjacent to the right side of the AFP package, preventing a clear, uninterrupted soil gap around the package footprint. The line runs in a parallel furrow and does not touch, cross, or emerge from the package. There is one required white-and-blue AFP package and no distinct extra loose coil or roll is visible. No white ribbon, strap, or tape tail is seen protruding from the package sides or base.

acceptance_warnings: Independent physical condition not met: clear_soil_gap
